name: Docusign Identify
description: Docusign Identify is an identity-verification product family for adding configured verification workflows to electronic-signature transactions. Organizations use it to choose provider-supported checks while Docusign manages the verification experience and evidence lifecycle.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Docusign integration key with one exact account, then let agents inspect approval-gated identity-verification workflow configuration metadata without exposing signers, evidence, documents, biometrics, or PII.

capabilities.label: Read identity-verification workflows
capabilities.description: Read bounded workflow identifiers, names and types from one exact Docusign account without signer or evidence data.

approvalRequired.label: List identity-verification workflows
approvalRequired.description: List bounded identity-verification workflow configuration metadata for one exact Docusign account.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded workflow-metadata read requires approval; signers, envelopes, identity evidence, documents, biometrics, PII, writes and raw APIs remain outside Relay V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The workflow-metadata read runs without per-action approval; exact-account binding, redaction, request bounds, provider scopes and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one typed workflow-metadata wrapper and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to Docusign UserInfo and the validated account regional API origin.
Relay mounts one typed workflow-metadata wrapper and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to Docusign UserInfo and the validated account regional API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Docusign account with ID Verification entitlement, an integration key, Go-Live approval, credentials, and consent validation are still required in the separate provider-console task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the exact Relay HTTPS callback on a customer-owned integration key, complete Go-Live, consent signature and extended, then verify default-account and regional-base binding, serialized refresh, the bounded workflow read, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Docusign documents Identify as the product umbrella and ID Verification as an eSignature REST API v2.1 workflow selected when creating recipient authentication requirements.
Docusign documents the account identify_verification endpoint for listing available identity-verification workflow definitions and using the resulting workflow identifier in envelopes.
Docusign documents ID Evidence as a separate, highly sensitive PII surface using short-lived resource tokens; Relay excludes the entire surface from V1.
Docusign describes ID Verification capabilities including document, biometric, liveness and partner methods, which remain outside Relay's metadata-only V1.
